description: This file contains a comprehensive suite of tests for the 'keys' module of a JavaScript project, focusing on encryption key management, protocol compliance, and account security workflows. It uses Mocha and Chai for testing, with various imported helper modules, and tests multiple scenarios involving root keys, items keys, passcodes, account registration, and key re-encryption.

classes.name: ServerSyncResponse
classes.description: Represents a response object for server synchronization, containing retrieved items payloads.

classes.name: EncryptedPayload
classes.description: Handles encrypted payload data, with methods to access encrypted content and associated metadata.

classes.name: DecryptedPayload
classes.description: Represents a decrypted payload, used to process and manage decrypted data.

methods.name: compare
methods.description: Compares two root key objects for equality.

methods.name: createRootKey
methods.description: Creates a new root key, specifying version, master key, server password, and other parameters.

methods.name: getLatestVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the latest supported protocol version.

methods.name: getRootKeyParams
methods.description: Obtains the parameters used for generating or validating root keys.

methods.name: itemsEncryption.keyToUseForItemEncryption
methods.description: Determines the appropriate items encryption key for encrypting an item.

methods.name: itemsKeyForPayload
methods.description: Retrieves the items key associated with a given payload.

methods.name: signIn
methods.description: Signs into an account with email and password.

methods.name: changePasscode
methods.description: Changes the account passcode, re-encrypting relevant keys.

methods.name: changePassword
methods.description: Changes the account password and manages related key updates.
